front: EM spectrum in order of increasing frequency?
back: Radio, microwaves, infrared, visible, ultraviolet, X-rays, gamma rays.

front: Speed of electromagnetic waves in a vacuum?
Properties shared by all EM waves?
back: Transverse; travel through a vacuum at the same speed; obey v = fλ; transfer energy.

front: Uses of radio waves, microwaves and infrared?
back: Radio: broadcasting. Microwaves: satellites, phones, ovens. Infrared: remote controls, heaters, thermal imaging.

front: Uses of ultraviolet, X-rays and gamma rays?
back: UV: security marks, sterilising water. X-rays: bone images, airport scanners. Gamma: sterilising, cancer treatment.
Microwaves: internal heating. Infrared: burns. UV: skin and eye damage. X-rays and gamma: mutation and cancer.
Shorter wavelength, more energy, and generally more harmful.
